lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਮਨਿ ਵੇਖਹੁ ਕੋ ਪਤੀਆਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: bin satigur kinai na paaio man vekhahu ko pateeaai ||
lines.translation: Without the True Guru, no one finds the Lord; anyone can try and see.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਭੇਟੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: har kirapaa te satigur paaeeai bhetai sahaj subhaai ||
lines.translation: By the Lord's Grace, the True Guru is found, and then the Lord is met with intuitive ease.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇਆ ਬਿਨੁ ਭਾਗਾ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: manamukh bharam bhulaaiaa bin bhaagaa har dhan na paai ||5||
lines.translation: The self-willed manmukh is deluded by doubt; without good destiny, the Lord's wealth is not obtained. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਸਭਾ ਧਾਤੁ ਹੈ ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: trai gun sabhaa dhaat hai paR paR karahi veechaar ||
lines.translation: The three dispositions are completely distracting; people read and study and contemplate them.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਨਹੁ ਪਾਇਨੑਿ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: mukat kade na hovaee nahu paainhi mokh duaar ||
lines.translation: Those people are never liberated; they do not find the Door of Salvation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬੰਧਨ ਨ ਤੁਟਹੀ ਨਾਮਿ ਨ ਲਗੈ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: bin satigur ba(n)dhan na tutahee naam na lagai piaar ||6||
lines.translation: Without the True Guru, they are never released from bondage; they do not embrace love for the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਮੋਨੀ ਥਕੇ ਬੇਦਾਂ ਕਾ ਅਭਿਆਸੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: paR paR pa(n)dit monee thake bedaa(n) kaa abhiaas ||
lines.translation: The Pandits, the religious scholars, and the silent sages, reading and studying the Vedas, have grown weary.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਨਹ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਵਾਸੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: har naam chit na aavaee nah nij ghar hovai vaas ||
lines.translation: They do not even think of the Lord's Name; they do not dwell in the home of their own inner being.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ਸਿਰਹੁ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਕਪਟ ਵਿਣਾਸੁ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: jamakaal sirahu na utarai a(n)tar kapat vinaas ||7||
lines.translation: The Messenger of Death hovers over their heads; they are ruined by the deceit within themselves. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਵੈ ਨੋ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਪਰਤਾਪਦਾ ਵਿਣੁ ਭਾਗਾਂ ਪਾਇਆ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: har naavai no sabh ko parataapadaa vin bhaagaa(n) paaiaa na jaai ||
lines.translation: Everyone longs for the Name of the Lord; without good destiny, it is not obtained.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: nadar kare gur bheteeai har naam vasai man aai ||
lines.translation: When the Lord bestows His Glance of Grace, the mortal meets the True Guru, and the Lord's Name comes to dwell within the mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੇ ਹੀ ਪਤਿ ਊਪਜੈ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਰਹਾਂ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੮॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak naame hee pat oopajai har siu rahaa(n) samaai ||8||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, through the Name, honor wells up, and the mortal remains immersed in the Lord. ||8||2||
Malaar, Third Mehl, Ashtpadheeyaa, Second House:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਕਾਰੈ ਲਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: har har kripaa kare gur kee kaarai laae ||
lines.translation: When the Lord shows His Mercy, He enjoins the mortal to work for the Guru.
His pains are taken away, and the Lord's Name comes to dwell within.
True deliverance comes by focusing one's consciousness on the True Lord.
Listen to the Shabad, and the Word of the Guru's Bani. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਿ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: man mere har har sev nidhaan ||
lines.translation: O my mind, serve the Lord, Har, Har, the true treasure.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur kirapaa te har dhan paaeeai anadin laagai sahaj dhiaan ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: By Guru's Grace, the wealth of the Lord is obtained. Night and day, focus your meditation on the Lord. ||1||Pause||
The soul-bride who adorns herself without her Husband Lord,
is ill-mannered and vile, wasted away into ruin.
This is the useless way of life of the self-willed manmukh.
Forgetting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, he performs all sorts of empty rituals. ||2||
The bride who is Gurmukh is beautifully embellished.
Through the Word of the Shabad, she enshrines her Husband Lord within her heart.
She realizes the One Lord, and subdues her ego.
That soul-bride is virtuous and noble. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਦਾਤੇ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: bin gur daate kinai na paaiaa ||
lines.translation: Without the Guru, the Giver, no one finds the Lord.
The greedy self-willed manmukh is attracted and engrossed in duality.
Only a few spiritual teachers realize this,

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਭੇਟੇ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: bin gur bhete mukat na hoi ||4||
lines.translation: that without meeting the Guru, liberation is not obtained. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਕਹਿ ਕਹਣੁ ਕਹੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kahi kahi kahan kahai sabh koi ||
lines.translation: Everyone tells the stories told by others.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਮਨ ਮੂਏ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: bin man mooe bhagat na hoi ||
lines.translation: Without subduing the mind, devotional worship does not come.
When the intellect achieves spiritual wisdom, the heart-lotus blossoms forth.
The Naam, the Name of the Lord, comes to abide in that heart. ||5||
In egotism, everyone can pretend to worship God with devotion.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਮਨੁ ਭੀਜੈ ਨਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: naa man bheejai naa sukh hoi ||
lines.translation: But this does not soften the mind, and it does not bring peace.
By speaking and preaching, the mortal only shows off his self-conceit.
His devotional worship is useless, and his life is a total waste. ||6||
They alone are devotees, who are pleasing to the Mind of the True Guru.
Night and day, they remain lovingly attuned to the Name.
They behold the Naam, the Name of the Lord, ever-present, near at hand.
